# OEE

## setup

```{r}
library(scatterplot3d)
options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
library(rgl)

base_folder = "../../new_data/"
```

Read data

```{r}

folder = "trees/_good-2024_10_16_15_49" 

# honestly this one seems to be the best even if the video is not great
# folder = "/Users/lana/Desktop/prgm/old/oee-old-01/0_OEE/2015_10_05_01_19"

fileName = paste(base_folder, folder,"SummaryIndividuals.csv",sep="/")
# fileName = paste(base_folder, folder,"xad",sep="/")

whole_world <- read.csv(fileName, stringsAsFactors=F, dec =".")#, header=TRUE)
# create a vector the same length as the dataframe
sample_vector=c(1:nrow(whole_world))
# sample elements from the vector (in this example 30 elements sampled without replacement)
the_sample = sample(sample_vector, 30000, replace=FALSE)
# the vector of randomly selected elements is then used to select rows from the dataframe
world = whole_world[the_sample,]

```


```{r}
colnames(world) = cl
```

```{r}
cl = colnames(world)
```

Read predation data

```{r}

folder = "2024_11_03_13_26" 
fileName = paste(base_folder, folder,"predation.csv",sep="/")

interactions <- read.csv(fileName, stringsAsFactors=F, dec =".", header=TRUE)
```



```{r}
l = length(interactions$r_pred)
interactions$int_id = c(1:l)

# subset
late_interactions = subset(interactions, t>50500)

colors_pred =  rgb(late_interactions$r_pred, late_interactions$g_pred, late_interactions$b_pred, maxColorValue=255)
colors_prey =  rgb(late_interactions$r_prey, late_interactions$g_prey, late_interactions$b_prey, maxColorValue=255)
```


```{r}
plot(x = interactions$int_id, y = rep(1, l), col = colors_pred, ylim = c(-1,2))
points(x = interactions$int_id, y = rep(0, l), col = colors_prey)
```


Divide predators in color clusters

```{r}
# plot predators
plot(late_interactions$r_pred, late_interactions$g_pred, col = colors_pred)

plot(late_interactions$g_prey, late_interactions$b_prey, col = colors_prey)

# plot preys as function of predators
plot(late_interactions$r_pred, late_interactions$g_pred, col = colors_prey)

```
